reason: I'd make a free account and poke at it, because ₹99 is nothing, but I don't pay for a tool until it has shown me something true about my own channel in Hindi. An AI that has only ever seen English YouTube data sounds like it will tell me to 'post more Shorts' and miss what my Hindi comments are actually saying.
objection: Will it really understand the difference between a Hindi-Hinglish video and a Telugu one, and the way my audience talks, or will it just give generic growth advice translated badly?
would_change_my_mind: If I connect my channel for free and it names a specific video of mine that beat my usual views and gives a reason I can check against my own comments, in language that sounds like how my audience talks.
